Hankinnan ennakoitu arvonlisäveroton kokonaisarvo on noin 150 000 euroa neljän vuoden tarkastelujakson aikana. Tukesin viestinnän ja näkyvyyden hallinnan hankintakokonaisuuteen kuuluu nyt kilpailutettavien palvelujen lisäksi uutiskirjepalvelu, jonka ennakoitu arvo on samalla laskentaperusteella noin 30 000 euroa. title: Oldham Live Well Evaluation
description: GM Live Well is Greater Manchester's commitment to ensuring great every day support is available in every neighbourhood. It represents a shift in how public services work with people and communities. Live Well is a partnership between NHS GM, 10GM and GMCA, the 10 local authorities, health, business, the Voluntary, Community, Faith and social enterprise sector and people and communities. Working together to create conditions for people to thrive, not just survive, removing barriers to opportunity and tackling health, social and economic inequalities. In 2023, with support from The National Lottery Community Fund, the Live Well programme was launched, enabling five accelerator sites to lead work (one of which was Oldham) to tackle persistent barriers to Live Well. These areas are a part of a growing movement for community-led health and wellbeing, connecting and amplifying existing, brilliant support in GM's communities During 2025, Live Well's strategic remit has expanded, and it has grown to become Greater Manchester's catalyst for delivering long held prevention and reform ambitions. Live Well will bring about a radical shift in public service delivery at a neighbourhood level, underpinned by transformational and new ways of working between and across the statutory sector, Voluntary, Community Faith and Social Enterprise sector, and communities. Live Well is focussed on prevention and health creation. Live Well is not a programme or service but a whole system approach to changing how we work with communities and in our public service systems, to grow community power, wealth and action. • It is community-led - led by Greater Manchester's communities who determine and take action on what is important to them. This means supporting leadership, voice and capacity within communities of place, identity, interest and experience - particularly those most impacted by structural inequalities, racism and injustice. • It is system-enabled - it works to transform the system to enable community action, power and wealth to flourish. This means unblocking persistent barriers and building shared purpose, collective accountability and responsive leadership across neighbourhoods and public services.

title: Pharmaceutical Dispensing Services including the Supply and Delivery of Medicine

- Out of hours medication supplies.
- Out of hours pharmaceutical clinical advice.

title: Flexible Framework Agreement for the Provision of Alcohol and Drug Recovery Services and Supports in South and East Ayrshire
description: This procurement exercise is a collaboration between South Ayrshire Council and East Ayrshire Council on behalf of the South Ayrshire Alcohol and Drug Partnership (SAADP) and the East Ayrshire Alcohol and Drug Partnership (EAADP), with South Ayrshire Council (the Council) acting as the lead contracting authority. The Council has a requirement to establish a multi-lot Flexible Framework Agreement (FFA) comprising of a range of suitably qualified Service Providers capable of delivering high-quality alcohol and drug recovery services and supports. The FFA is intended to create a flexible and sustainable framework through which the SAADP and EAADP can award call-off contracts and/or partnership agreements, either through direct award or by conducting a further competition. The scope of the FFA falls within the ‘Social and Other Specific Services’ category and is subject to the procurement regimes set out under the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015. As such, this “Light Touch Regime” allows a flexible approach which will permit new entrants to submit tender offers for inclusion of services and supports on the FFA or will allow existing Service Providers to apply for inclusion of new services or supports to the FFA.

title: The Provision of a Mental Health Crisis Text Support Service on behalf of NHS Cheshire and Merseyside Integrated Care Board
description: NHS Cheshire and Merseyside is seeking to engage with the market regarding the provision of an all-age, 24-hour, 7 days a week/ 365 days a year Mental Health Crisis Text Service across Cheshire and Merseyside. The service will provide immediate, accessible and inclusive text-based support for individuals experiencing a mental health crisis and will operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The service is intended to be fully integrated with NHS 111 (Mental Health Option) and local crisis response pathways, ensuring seamless access to urgent mental health support and onward referral where required. The service has been developed in line with NHS England guidance on urgent and emergency mental health care and supports the objectives of the NHS Long Term Plan, the Urgent and Emergency Care Recovery Plan, and national suicide prevention priorities. It aims to improve access to crisis support for people who may experience barriers to traditional services, including those affected by stigma, communication difficulties, disability, sensory needs, or geographical isolation across the region's diverse urban and rural communities. The term of the contract is 2 years, with the option to extend for 2 further periods of up to one year each. The extension options are not guaranteed and will be subject to ongoing service requirements, satisfactory performance, available funding and approval by the Authority. The maximum total contract value, including both potential extensions, is £1,400,000 ex VAT. title: BHCC Adults Community Support and Supported Living Light Touch Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) Admission Round 4
description: Brighton and Hove City Council (BHCC) established a Light Touch Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for the supply of services in respect of Community Support and Supported Living for adults on 4th March 2024 for an initial period of up to 5 years + with optional further extension provisions for an additional 3 years + 2 years. The end of the initial contract term of the DPS is 3rd March 2029. This Contract Notice is for the fourth admission round onto the DPS. The services required fall under Schedule 3 of the Public Contracts Regulations 2015 (PCR 2015). As a result, this procurement is undertaken under the 'Light Touch Regime' as detailed in Section 7 of PCR 2015. Any interested organisation or consortium with relevant experience may apply to be admitted onto the DPS. The DPS will have two (2) lots and be further divided into sub-lots as follows: Lot 1: Community Support Lot 1.1: Adults with Learning Disabilities and who may also be autistic Lot 1.2: Adults with Mental Health needs Lot 1.3: Adults who are Neurodivergent and who may also be autistic Lot 1.4: Adults with Acquired Brain Injuries (ABI) Lot 1.5: Adults with Physical Disabilities and/or sensory needs Lot 1.6: Adults with Substance Misuse and eligible Care Act needs Lot 2: Supported Living, for people with: Lot 2.1: Adults with Learning Disabilities and who may also be autistic Lot 2.2: Adults with Mental Health needs Lot 2.3: Adults who are Neurodivergent and who may also be autistic Lot 2.4: Adults with Acquired Brain Injuries (ABI) Lot 2.5: Adults with Physical Disabilities and/or sensory needs Lot 2.6: Adults with Substance Misuse and eligible Care Act needs Potential Providers are invited to apply for one lot or sub-lot; or multiple lots and sub-lots. The Brighton & Hove commissioning strategy is to reduce the number of people in residential care, placed out of the city and in long term services that do not meet their needs. Supported Living and Community Support are effective in meeting this goal. The aim of the DPS is to: - Ensure that all providers on the DPS have met quality requirements and signed up to a new service specification that reflects the needs that people who receive support and their carers have identified. - Attract new providers to the market and create a more diverse market that provides more choice for people who receive support. - Ensure a more strengths-based approach that focus on outcomes for people who receive support. - Enable the Council to meet the care and support needs of residents who have been assessed as having eligible social care needs in line with the Care Act 2014 For each Lot, there will be an 'Admission' stage, followed by a 'Commissioning' stage. BHCC intends to open the 'Admission' stage annually for new applications. The Council reserves the right to revise the number of rounds ('opening ceremonies') for Admission stage per year at its discretion. By applying to be admitted to the DPS, Providers are not obligated to bid for services at 'Commissioning' stage. These services are being procured under a multiple-Provider DPS. There will be no limit to the number of Providers admitted onto the DPS, providing they meet the minimum requirements as set out in the Invitation to Tender documents. There will be no guarantee of work or volume of work given under this DPS. Admission stage evaluation will be based on 100% Quality. For Lot 1: Community Support, Pricing will be requested and will be binding until 31st March 2028 but will not be scored. This pricing will be used at Stage 2: Commissioning Stage for Direct Awards.

title: B2B Matchmaking Services in France
description: The Embassy of Canada in France is seeking the services of an experienced contractor to deliver the Business-to-Business (B2B) program for Canadian companies during an upcoming trade mission to France. The contractor will organize a series of business-to-business (B2B) matchmaking meetings that will take place from February 14 to 16, 2027, in Paris France. The B2B meetings will focus on six (6) priority sectors: 1. Critical Minerals (rare earths - both extraction and processing - nickel, lithium, tungsten, cobalt, gallium) 2. Clean Technology (CCUS, smart power grids, EV, decarbonation, water and wastewater) 3. Defence and Security (Land, naval, non-civilian aerospace and space, cyber, joint operations, autonomous systems and robotics) 4. Energy (hydrogen, LNG) 5. ICT (Artificial intelligence, quantum, cloud infrastructure, cyber-security, robotics) 6. Life Sciences (pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices and medtech, digital health, precision medicine, and AI-enabled health innovation) For more information, please refer to the Request for Proposals documents in the bidding details section.

title: Netherlands – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Implementatie & Beheer Partner SAP
description: De gemeente Amsterdam bereidt de aanbesteding voor van een Implementatie & Beheer Partner (IBP) voor haar SAP-omgeving. De aanbesteding wordt ingericht volgens de Mededingings Procedure met Onderhandeling (MPMO). De procedure bestaat uit twee fasen: 1) Selectiefase en 2) Inschrijvingsfase. De opdracht bestaat uit 2 samenhangende onderdelen: 1) Implementatiefase en 2) Applicatief beheer. Na publicatie van de selectieleidraad organiseert de gemeente een plenaire (facultatieve) informatiebijeenkomst voor geïnteresseerde marktpartijen. Nadere details en aanmeldvoorwaarden volgen in de Selectieleidraad. De gemeente zal, na bestuurlijke besluitvorming, de aanbesteding publiceren op 21 oktober 2026. Dit betreft slechts een vooraankondiging en dient uitsluitend ter informatie van de markt zodat partijen zich tijdig kunnen voorbereiden. Aan deze vooraankondiging kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. De formele aanbestedingsdocumenten en voorwaarden worden gepubliceerd op Mercell.

title: Finland – Cooling and ventilation equipment – Ilmanvaihtosuodattimet -puitejärjestely
description: Hankinnan kohteena ovat kaikkien ilmanvaihtokoneiden suodattimet puitejärjestely, jotka kohdistuvat Pääkaupunkiseudun Kaupunkiliikenne Oy:n (KLOY), Helsingin kaupungin liikenneliikelaitoksen (HKL), Länsimetro Oy:n (Länsimetro), Ruskeasuon Varikkokiinteistö Oy:n, Sammalvuoren Metrovarikko Oy:n (SMV), RV Kalusto ja Varikko Oy:n (KAVA) sekä Helsingin Joukkoliikenneinfra Oy:n (jäljempänä yhdessä Tilaaja) omistamiin tai ylläpitovastuulla oleviin tiloihin, rakennuksiin ja kiinteistöihin. Tilaajat tekevät jokainen itsenäisen hankintapäätöksen ja allekirjoittavat omat hankintasopimukset tarjouskilpailun perusteella valittavien Toimittajien kanssa. Selvennyksen vuoksi todetaan, että Kaupunkiliikenne edustaa kaikkia Tilaajia sopimuksen mukaisten palveluiden suorittamiseen liittyvissä asioissa. Puitejärjestely ei sisällä määrä- tai vähimmäisostovelvoitetta eikä se tuota toimittajalle yksinoikeutta hankinnan kohteena olevien ilmanvaihtosuodattimien tuottamiseen Tilaajalle. Tilaaja hankkii ilmanvaihtosuodattimia tarpeen mukaan erillisten tilausten perusteella. Tarjouskilpailun perusteella puitejärjestelyyn valitaan enintään kolme (3) toimittajaa edullisuusjärjestyksen mukaan. Edullisuusjärjestys määräytyy Liitteen 1 kokonaisvertailuarvon mukaan, pienin vertailuluku on paras. Puitejärjestelyn sisäiset hankinnat tehdään etusijajärjestyksen perusteella. 1.Toimittaja tarkoittaa puitejärjestelyssä etusijajärjestyksen mukaan ensimmäiseksi sijoittunutta Toimittajaa. 2. Toimittaja tarkoittaa puitejärjestelyssä etusijajärjestyksen mukaan toiseksi sijoittunutta Toimittajaa. 3. Toimittaja tarkoittaa puitejärjestelyssä etusijajärjestyksen mukaan kolmanneksi sijoittunutta Toimittajaa. Tilaaja tekee toimitusta koskevat tilaukset pääsääntöisesti 1. Toimittajalta. Puitejärjestelyn toimintaperiaate on kuvattu sopimuksella kohdassa 3. Tarkempi tuoteluettelo esitetään liitteessä 1 Tarjouslomake. Kohteet sijaitsevat pääkaupunkiseudulla, jossa ulkoilman hiukkaskuormitus on korkea mm. liikenteen, katupölyn ja jatkuvan rakentamisen vuoksi. Hankinnan tavoitteet ovat järjestelmien likaantumisen, huoltovälien ja toimintariskien vähentäminen koko elinkaaren aikana kuin myös korkealaatuinen sisäilma, energiatehokkuus ja vastuullisuus huomioiden suodattimien koko elinkaaren ympäristövaikutukset sisältäen valmistuksen, käytön ja hävityksen. Näistä syistä esisuodattimen vähimmäisvaatimukseksi on asetettu Coarse 80 %. Suodattimet on testattava ja luokiteltava SFS-EN ISO 16890 -standardin mukaisesti (ePM1/ePM2,5/ePM10) tai Tarjoajan on muulla luotettavalla tavalla osoitettava, että tuote täyttää vähintään vastaavat suorituskykyvaatimukset. Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta. Tilaajilla on oikeus jatkaa sopimusta kahdella (2) kahden (2) vuoden optiokaudella (yht. enintään 6 vuotta). Ennakoitu arvo (alv 0 %): 1.065.000,00 euroa koko sopimuskaudelle optioineen. Ennakoitu arvo yhtiöittäin: Pääkaupunkiseudun Kaupunkiliikenne Oy: 100.000,00 euroa Sammalvuoren Varikko Oy: 120.000,00 euroa Ruskeasuon Varikkokiinteistö Oy: 100.000,00 euroa Helsingin Kaupungin Liikenneliikelaitos: 250.000,00 euroa Länsimetro Oy: 350.000,00 euroa RV Kalusto ja Varikko Oy: 100.000,00 euroa Helsingin Joukkoliikenneinfra Oy: 45.000,00 euroa Tarjouspyynnön liitteet: Liite 0 Sopimusluonnos Liite 1 Tarjouslomake Liite 2 Kuvaus käytössä olevasta ympäristöjärjestelmästä Liite 3 Kuvaus käytössä olevasta laadunhallintajärjestelmästä Liite 4 Yhteyshenkilöt Liite 5 JYSE 2025 Tavarat

title: IT Professional Services to Enhance and Deliver the Canada Disability Benefit Digital Solution
description: For Clarity Purposes - Additional Description Details added 2026-11-03 As per the Notice of Proposed Procurement (NPP) : This procurement is set aside under the federal government Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business. For more information on Indigenous business requirements of the Set-aside Program for Indigenous Business, refer to Annex 9.4 of the Supply Manual. Therefore, this requirement is open to only Indigenous TBIPS Supply Arrangement Holders under EN578-170432 who qualified under Tier 1, under the Remote/Virtual Access region, level of expertise and for the following categories: Stream 1: Applications Services A.1 Application/Software Architect – Level 3 A.6 Programmer/Software Developer – Level 3 Stream 6: Cyber protection services C.6. Information Technology Security Engineer – Level 3 ****************************** This procurement seeks to secure specialized and advance IT Professional Services TBIPS Consultants, who have skill sets not available internally. Employment and Social Development Canada’s (ESDC) Innovation, Information & Technology Branch (IITB), requires specialized IT professional services to enhance and deliver the Canada Disability Benefit (CDB) digital solution. Application Architects, Software Developers, and Security Engineers will design, develop, integrate, test, and secure new program functionalities, APIs, and backend systems using an Agile delivery approach. Through accessibility-focused design, rigorous testing, and secure system integration, this work will streamline benefit applications, improve the accuracy and timeliness of payments, and strengthen service delivery. As a result, Canadians with disabilities will benefit from a more accessible, efficient, and reliable process for accessing financial supports.

title: Wharf Replacement - St Bride's - NL
description: 1. TITLE Wharf Reconstruction – St. Bride’s, NL for Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) 2. SCOPE OF WORK The work consists of the furnishing of all plant, labour, equipment and material for wharf reconstruction at St. Bride’s, NL, in strict accordance with specifications and accompanying drawings and subject to all terms and conditions of the Contract. Work will consist of, but will not necessarily be limited to, the following: • Demolition and removal of the existing northwest breakwater wharf, as noted on the drawings. Contractor to note that any creosote timber encountered will have to be disposed of at a provincially regulated waste disposal site. • Construction of a new treated timber crib wharf (northwest breakwater wharf), complete with reinforced concrete deck, structural deck and concrete spraywall, to the dimensions as indicated on the drawings. Note that the outer headblock section of the wharf requires the seaward side crib bays to be filled with concrete. • Supply and installation of mooring cleats, structural timber for coping, wheelguard, wheelguard blocking, fenders, ladders and associated hardware for the new northwest breakwater wharf. • Electrical work, as noted on the drawings (includes a new electrical shed) for the northwest breakwater wharf. • Electrical upgrades to Structure #408 on the south end of harbour (including new shed, pedestals on elevated bases, wiring, trenching and 600mm diameter HDPE culvert). 3. FAMILIARIZATION WITH SITE Before submitting a bid, bidders can visit the site and its surroundings, at their own expense and schedule, to review and verify the form, nature, and extent of the work, materials needed for the completion of the work, the means of access to the site, site remoteness, severity, exposure, and uncertainty of weather, soil conditions, any accommodations they may require, and in general shall obtain all necessary information as to risks, contingencies, and other circumstances which may influence or affect their bid. No allowance shall be made subsequently in this connection on account or error or negligence to properly observe and determine the conditions that will apply. Take all appropriate safety measures for any visit to site, either before or after acceptance of bid. 4. CONTRACT PERIOD It is anticipated the contractor can perform and complete the work no later than March 31, 2030. All work shall be completed in accordance with the Contract Documents.

title: Taidekasarmin muutos ja peruskorjaus, kokonaisurakoitsijan hankinta
description: Taidekasarmin muutos ja peruskorjaus, kokonaisurakoitsijan hankinta Rakennus on valmistunut vuonna 1915, ja se kuuluu Hyrylän kasarmialueen toiseen rakennuskauteen. Kyseessä on yksikerroksinen, massiivitiilirakenteinen rakennus, jossa on ullakko. Rakennuksen omistaa Tuusulan kunta ja se on asemakaavassa suojeltu kulttuurihistoriallisesti ja aluekokonaisuuden kannalta arvokkaana kohteena (sr-24). Rakennus sijaitsee pohjavesialueella. Hanke kattaa rakennuksen peruskorjauksen sekä käyttötarkoituksen muutoksen ravintolaksi. Lisäksi naapuritontille rakennetaan uusi, noin 45 m²:n huoltorakennus, johon tulee ravintolan jätetila. Huoltorakennus toteutetaan poikkeamispäätöksen perusteella ja sen tieltä puretaan nykyinen jätekatos. Huoltoliikenne järjestetään Esikunnanpolun kautta. Kunta tekee urakka-alueen ulkopuolisen varsinaisen katualueen työt. Tilaaja on aiemmin purkanut rakennuksen alapohjan betonirakenteet sekä suurimman osan yläpohjan ei-kantavista rakenteista. Peruskorjauksessa tehdään uudet alapohjarakenteet. Lisäksi sokkeli mantteloidaan teräsbetonilla, kantaviin tiiliseiniin injektoidaan kapillaarikatko ja ensimmäisen kerroksen kattoon asennetaan teräksiset jäykistys- ja vahvistusrakenteet. Osa sisäpuolisista rappauksista poistetaan, ja tiilipinnat puhdistetaan. Julkisivu ja ikkunat kunnostetaan. Ravintolarakennukseen tehdään lisäksi kaksi uutta poistumistieovea, esteetön sisäänkäynti portaineen ja luiskineen, terassi, huoltotaso ja lastauslaituri portaineen ja luiskineen sekä ullakolle johtava kierreporras. Sisätiloihin tehdään ravintolatoiminnan edellyttämät muutokset, kuten valmistuskeittiö ja kylmiöt. Ullakko otetaan osittain käyttöön IV-konehuoneina. Vesikatolle asennetaan uudet IV-konehuoneiden piiput, vesikattovarusteet sekä uudet savunpoisto- ja kattoluukut. Käyttötarkoituksen muutos edellyttää taloteknisten järjestelmien kattavaa uusimista. Rakennustöissä on otettava huomioon haitta-ainekartoitus, kunto- ja rakennetutkimukset sekä museoviranomaisen lausunnot. Ravintolarakennus ja huoltorakennus toteutetaan P1-puhtausluokan mukaisesti. Tarkemmat tekniset ratkaisut on esitetty suunnittelualakohtaisissa työselostuksissa ja erikoissuunnitelmissa. Urakka-alue on asemapiirustuksen mukainen, ja siihen kuuluu myös huoltoliikenne- ja puistoaluetta. Tavoitteena on, että käyttäjä pääsee kalustamaan rakennusta ravintolakäyttöä varten loppuvuodesta 2027 (tarkempi ajankohta tarkentuu myöhemmin).,

title: Puolustuskiinteistöt ja Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos / Sotilaskalusteet
description: Hankinnan kohteena on sotilaskalusteet. Hankinta on jaettu 4 eri osa-alueeseen Osa-alue 1. Sotilassängyt (vakio sänky ja ylipitkä sänky 220 cm) Osa-alue 2. Sängynpäädyt Osa-alue 3. Sotilaskaapit (vanha ja uusi malli) Osa-alue 4. Pöytäkaluste Puolustuskiinteistöt voi hankkia osa-alueiden 1-3 tuotteita. Osa-alueesta 3 sotilaskaappi vanha malli ei kuulu Puolustuskiinteistöjen hankinnan kohteeseen ja osa-alue 4 Pöytäkalusteet ei kuulu Puolustuskiinteistöjen hankinnan kohteeseen eikä Puolustuskiinteistöt voi tehdä niistä tilauksia. Puolustusvoimat voi hankkia osa-alueiden 2–4 tuotteita. Osa-alue 1 Sängyt ei kuulu Puolustusvoimien hankinnan kohteeseen, eikä Puolustusvoimat voi tehdä kyseistä osa-aluetta koskevia tilauksia. Jokaiseen osa-alueeseen valitaan yksi (1) sopimustoimittaja. Kuljetus ja asennus sisältyvät hankinnan hintaan. Hankinnan kokonaisarvo on noin 9 160 000 milj. € (alv 0%). Senaatti-kiinteistöt toteuttaa hankinnan Puolustuskiinteistöjen toimeksiannosta ja Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitoksen valtuutuksella. Senaatti-kiinteistöt vastaa hankintaprosessin käytännön toteutuksesta. Kumpikin tilaaja tekee kilpailutuksen perusteella oman erillisen hankintasopimuksensa kyseiselle osa-alueelle valitun toimittajan kanssa. Kumpikin tilaaja vastaa oman sopimuksensa mukaisista tilauksista, maksuista ja sopimuksen hallinnasta. title: CHL NBC VE 4750 Deckenlifter
description: Das Klinikum Centre Hospitalier de Luxembourg beabsichtigt im Zuge des Neubaus mehrere Deckenlaufschienen bzw. Deckenlifter (mit elektromotorischer Höhenverstellung inkl. Unterkonstruktionen) gemäß dem Vergabeverfahren „Buch II Offenes Verfahren (Loi, Art. 63 und 65)" zu beschaffen. Bestandteil der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung und Montage von: - 24 Deckenlaufschiene mit quer über Patientenplatz verfahrbarer Schiene mit Infusionshalter - 2 Patientenliftersystem, U/B-Raum / Umbettschleuse als 1-Bett-Schwerlastzimmer - 53 Patientenlifter für 1-Bett-Standardzimmer (Allgemeinpflege) - 2 Patientenliftersystem über WC hinwegführend, 1-Bett-Schwerlastzimmer (Allgemeinpflege) - 45 Patientenliftersystem mit Infusionsdeckenschiene, 1-Bett-Standardzimmer (Intensivpflege) - 2 Patientenliftersystem mit Infusionsdeckenschiene inkl. Infusionsstange, 1-Bett-Schwerlastzimmer (Intensivpflege) - 1 Patientenliftersystem mit Infusionsdeckenschiene inkl. Infusionsstange, 2-Bett-Schwerlastzimmer (Intensivpflege) - 2 Patientenliftersystem über CT / Parkposition hinwegführend (CT/CT Notfall) - 20 Patientenlifter, fahrbar Die Lieferung und Montage der Bestandteile soll nach dem folgenden Prioritäten-Schema getrennt ablaufen: Montage Unterkonstruktionen, Montage Deckenlifter, Lieferung Zubehör unmittelbar vor Inbetriebnahme (Diebstahlprävention). Die Einstellung von Anschlägen im Drehbereich ist mit den Nutzern/Vertretern durchzuführen. 1 Haupt- und 1 Nachbesserungstermin sind mit dem Angebotspreis abgegolten, wobei die Teilleistungen gemäß Terminplan gestaffelt einzutakten und mit der örtlichen Bauleitung/Fachbauleitung abzustimmen sind. Die gesetzliche Verjährungsfrist der Gewährleistungsansprüche beginnt mit der Abnahme der Leistung. Der Tag der Abnahme (komplette Montage inklusive Mängelbeseitigungen) ist der Gewährleistungsbeginn. Folgende Leistungen sind neben den gerätebezogenen Leistungen anzubieten und zu kalkulieren: - Bei der Kollisionsprüfung durch den koordinierenden Architekten (4Bund) ist durch den Auftragnehmer (AN) mitzuwirken. Die Montagepläne sind bei Erfordernis anzupassen. - Für Organisationsbesprechungen - auch teil- und abschnittsweise - hat der AN einen mit der Anlage in allen Teilen technisch und betrieblich vertrauten, sachkundigen Mitarbeiter beizustellen. - Weitere Leitungen gemäß den zusätzlichen technischen Vorbemerkungen der Medizintechnik Eignungskriterien gemäß allgemeinen und besonderen Vertragsbedingungen, Punkt 1.10 / Punkt 2.10 Für die Lieferungen und Montagen der Geräte sind folgende Termine maßgebend: Möglicher Beginn Einbau: 04.10.2027 Spätester Abschluss Montagen: 29.03.2029 (Innenausbau + Technik gem. Generalablaufplan_V5) Unter Berücksichtigung des Starttermins ist ein Montageterminplan vorzulegen und ggf. an Vorgaben des Architekten (4Bund) anzupassen. Die jeweils für die Einbringung und Montage benötigten Zeiten sind pro Gerätetyp zu hinterlegen.

title: Detaljprosjektering av VA-anlegg Vennerød–Gravdal
description: Bakgrunn Sandefjord kommune skal knytte sammen VA-nettet mellom Andebu og Stokke. Prosjektet er delt i flere etapper. Etappe 2, som inkluderer pumpestasjonene Vennerød og Fossnes samt ledningen mellom dem, er under detaljprosjektering. COWI er ansvarlig prosjekterende for denne etappen, som skal ferdigstilles ved årsskiftet 2026/2027. Etappe 3 omfatter sammenkoblingen mellom Vennerød og Gravdal. Oppdraget gjelder vurdering og valg av deltrasé samt komplett detaljprosjektering av VA-anlegget og nødvendig geoteknisk detaljprosjektering, slik at kommunen får et komplett grunnlag for utlysning og gjennomføring av entreprisen. Beskrivelse av oppdraget For beskrivelse av oppdraget vises det til vedlegg Oppdragsbeskrivelse og øvrige vedlegg til konkurransen.

title: EL Materiell og El- Tjenester i Vågan kommune
description: Vågan Kommune konsern inviterer til konkurranse med forhandling om rammeavtale på levering av elektriker tjenester og materiell i forbindelse med drift av Vågan kommune konsern og Lofoten IKT. Det er to leverandører som vil bli tildelt under hver kategori. For å få en god nRammeavtalen er ikke eksklusiv. Oppdragsgiver kan velge å gjennomføre egne konkurranser for oppdrag som har en estimert verdi på minst kr. 200.000 eksl. mva. Avtalen skal gjelde i 24 mnd. med opsjon på forlengelse på (1+1) år. Lengden på kontrakten forutsetter at ikke maks sum som estimeres til kr. 30 mill. er benyttet.Vedlegg 2 til konkurransegrunnlaget er prisskjema. Prisskjema består av en forside, 1 faner med El-produkter, 3 faner med ulike tjeneste kostnader som automasjon, IKT, tjenester for vann og avløp og elektrikertjenester og 2 faner med forklaringer. Les sidene med forklaringer nøye.

title: Finland – Radio, television, communication, telecommunication and related equipment – Matkapuhelimien ja niihin liittyvien tarvikkeiden ja palvelujen hankinta
description: Salon kaupunki (jäljempänä hankintayksikkö / tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia matkapuhelimien ja niihin liittyvien tarvikkeiden ja palvelujen hankinnasta tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena on matkapuhelimien, niihin liittyvien tarvikkeiden sekä hankinnassa määriteltyjen palveluiden toimittaminen. Hankinnan tavoitteena on muodostaa sopimusmalli, joka tukee laitteiden vakiointia, hallittavuutta ja pitkää elinkaarta ja hallittuja mallinvaihtoja sekä mahdollistaa kustannustehokkaan ja vaiheittaisen hankinnan sopimuskauden aikana. Hankinnassa asetetut vaatimukset perustuvat tietoturvallisuuden, hallittavuuden, käyttövarmuuden, suorituskyvyn ja elinkaarikustannusten hallinnan tarpeisiin sekä hankintayksikön käyttötarkoituksiin. Hankinnan sopimuskausi on kaksi vuotta sopimuksen allekirjoituksesta. Tilaaja varaa mahdollisuuden kahteen yhden vuoden pituiseen optiokauteen. Optiolla tarkoitetaan sopimuksen jatkamista alkuperäisin ehdoin. Tilaaja päättää optioiden käytöstä ja kestosta erikseen. Tavoitteena on, että sopimuskausi alkaa tammikuussa 2027. Hankintaan sisältyy useita laiteluokkia, jotka on tarkoitettu erilaisiin käyttötarpeisiin, Näitä ovat peruspuhelimet, älypuhelimet (eri vaatimustasoilla) ja kestävät puhelimet vaativiin käyttöolosuhteisiin. Laitteita koskevat yksityiskohtaiset vähimmäisvaatimukset, hallinta- ja tietoturvavaatimukset sekä saatavuutta ja elinkaarta koskevat vaatimukset on esitetty tarjouspyynnössä ja etenkin sen liitteessä 1. Hankintaan sisältyy lisäksi laitteiden käyttöönottoon, hallintaan, toimitukseen, huoltoon ja elinkaaren hallintaan liittyviä palveluita. Hankittavat palvelut ovat: - laitteiden rekisteröinti automaattisen käyttöönoton menetelmään - puhelintilauksessa tilattujen tarvikkeiden asennus - laitteiden toimittaminen - laiterekisteri toimitetuista laitteista - asiakkaan mobiililaitteiden huoltopalvelun kontaktipisteenä toimiminen - vanhojen laitteiden kierrätyksen järjestäminen Hankinnan kohde ja sen vaatimukset on kuvattu tarjouspyynnössä sekä liitteissä.

title: SWAG Cancer Alliance Lung Cancer Screening Programme
description: Bristol NHS Foundation Trust (BFT), as host organisation for the Somerset, Wiltshire, Avon and Gloucestershire (SWAG) Cancer Alliance, is seeking to appoint a provider to deliver a fully managed Lung Cancer Screening Programme across the Somerset, Wiltshire, Avon and Gloucestershire (SWAG) Cancer Alliance area. The procurement is being managed by Bristol and Weston NHS Purchasing Consortium (BWPC) on behalf of the Trust. The service will identify and engage eligible populations, deliver lung cancer screening services, provide low-dose CT (LDCT) scanning services, and ensure effective management of participant pathways in support of the early detection and diagnosis of lung cancer. The provider will be required to deliver a high-quality, accessible and equitable service that maximises uptake, reduces health inequalities, and complies with all relevant national standards and programme requirements. The contract term is 36 months, with the option to extend for up to two further periods of 12 months each, giving a maximum total contract duration of 60 months. Additional information is contained within the Invitation to Tender documentation available through SAP Ariba.

title: Request for Information: Flexoelectric Future
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) Multi X Office (MXO) seeks information to inform possible future research on flexoelectric materials. The Department of War (DoW) requires sensing and transduction technologies that operate under size, weight, power, communications, and environmental constraints. title: FACILITY RENTAL, SUPPLIES AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT SERVICES
description: Notice No.: 75N98027Q00118 The National Institutes of Health (NIH), National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke (NINDS), intends to award a purchase order to the Marine Biological Laboratory (MBL), Woods Hole, Massachusetts, for facility rental, supplies, and technical support services supporting the NINDS Division of Intramural Research, Molecular Neurophysiology Section�s Squid Research Program. Description of the Requirement NINDS requires an integrated combination of specialized laboratory facilities, marine specimen collection and holding infrastructure, live Atlantic longfin squid (Doryteuthis pealeii), laboratory supplies, and technical support services. These resources support research into the biophysical mechanisms governing electrical signaling and membrane fusion in nervous systems. Research activities include electrophysiological, molecular, and morphological studies of squid giant axons and associated neural tissues, including investigation of the potential role of the squid HAP2 homolog, DpHAP2, in neural membrane fusion and giant axon development. The requirement depends on timely access to freshly collected, viable specimens and laboratory facilities located near the coastal collection site. Laboratory and Support Facilities The acquisition includes: Two climate-controlled laboratory rooms totaling approximately 560 square feet, configured for squid giant axon and optic lobe electrophysiology and molecular assays. Workstations with tables incorporating cable cutouts for computer-based scientific acquisition systems. At least one adjacent equipment room for each laboratory. Access to centrifuges, balances, chemical fume hoods, ultra-low-temperature freezers, and cold rooms. Marine Infrastructure and Live Specimen Delivery The contractor must provide continuous, temperature-controlled running seawater holding tanks and live squid collection throughout the approximately six-month Atlantic squid season, generally May through October. The requirement includes delivery of requested quantities of live, vigorous Doryteuthis pealeii directly to the NINDS laboratory holding tanks twice weekly, with delivery days scheduled Monday through Saturday. Collection, holding, and delivery operations must preserve specimen viability and support timely access to neural tissue for the required research. Microscopy and Controlled Experimental Facilities The contractor must provide: Preparative microscopy services. Institutional access to specialized electron microscopy facilities, including a Carl Zeiss Microscopy SEM Supra 40 VP field-emission scanning electron microscope. Access to appropriately authorized radioisotope facilities suitable for low-energy radioisotope experiments. Access to cold rooms and chemical fume hoods. Technical, Computing, and Procurement Support The requirement includes on-site technical and computing support to configure and maintain scientific software, integrate laboratory instrumentation into scientific acquisition networks, support data servers, and maintain secure laboratory wireless connectivity. Additional support includes chemical ordering, laboratory consumables and reagents, equipment rental, hazardous material handling, and shipping logistics. The contractor must provide a monthly Excel supply ledger identifying item names, descriptions, manufacturers, catalog numbers, quantities, list and discounted prices, order and receipt dates, and supporting signed receiving documentation. Supply purchases requiring advance Government approval must be processed in accordance with the resulting award. Period and Place of Performance The anticipated period of performance consists of: Base Period: January 1, 2027�December 31, 2027. Option Period 1: January 1, 2028�December 31, 2028. Option Period 2: January 1, 2029�December 31, 2029. The place of performance is Woods Hole, Massachusetts 02543. The Government anticipates making an award before January 1, 2027, to support laboratory reservations, vessel scheduling, and preparation for the spring collection season. Justification for the Proposed Sole-Source Acquisition The Government intends to use the simplified acquisition procedures at FAR 12.201-1. The decision to restrict competition will be documented in accordance with FAR 12.102(a), applicable to acquisitions at or below the simplified acquisition threshold when only one source is available. Acquisition.GOV MBL is the proposed source because the requirement depends on an integrated combination of live marine specimen collection, continuous running seawater infrastructure, co-located research laboratories, specialized microscopy, controlled experimental facilities, and scientific technical support. This acquisition involves more than the rental of laboratory space or the purchase of biological specimens. The required research depends on coordinated access to live Atlantic squid and specialized laboratory infrastructure capable of supporting electrophysiological and molecular studies soon after collection. Based on the requiring activity�s technical assessment and market research, commercial specimen suppliers and alternative coastal research facilities have not been identified that can provide the complete combination of live collection capabilities, seawater holding infrastructure, dedicated laboratory space, adjacent equipment rooms, radioisotope facilities, specialized electron microscopy, and technical support required for this work. Obtaining individual elements from separate sources would not, by itself, satisfy the requirement for coordinated collection, specimen holding, and research operations at the coastal laboratory site. Delays or interruptions in access to viable specimens could compromise seasonal tissue collection and ongoing research. The Government therefore proposes to obtain the required facilities, supplies, and services from MBL. The proposed sole-source approach is contingent upon the Government�s determination, based on technical review and market research, that no other responsible source can satisfy all minimum technical and operational requirements. Response Information This notice is not a request for competitive quotations or proposals. However, interested parties that believe they can satisfy the Government�s requirements may submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to provide the complete integrated requirement. Capability statements should include sufficient technical information to demonstrate the firm�s ability to: Provide the required laboratory space, adjacent equipment rooms, and supporting laboratory equipment. Collect and deliver live, vigorous Doryteuthis pealeii twice weekly during the seasonal collection period. Provide continuous, temperature-controlled running seawater holding systems. Provide co-located facilities supporting timely use of viable neural tissue. Provide the specified electron microscopy access and preparative microscopy services. Provide suitable radioisotope facilities, cold rooms, and chemical fume hoods. Provide scientific computing, procurement, hazardous material, shipping, and supply reporting support. Meet the anticipated performance schedule and all other stated minimum technical and operational requirements. The Government will evaluate timely capability statements to determine whether another responsible source is capable of meeting the requirement and whether a competitive acquisition is appropriate. All responsible sources may submit a quotation in response to the subsequent solicitation, which will be considered by the agency. Capability statements must be submitted electronically to haunp@mail.nih.gov no later than December 4, 2026 @ 9:00am est. Please reference Notice No. 75N98027Q00118 in the subject line of the submission.

description: Amendment No. 0001 27 November 2026 Solicitation No. 70ZU0227Q0000083 USCGC POLAR STAR Thordon Bearings The purpose of this amendment is to correct the NAICS code stated in the solicitation description and to provide responses to questions received from industry. Question 1: Does the Nonmanufacturer Rule apply to this acquisition, and if so, has an SBA waiver been issued? Answer: No SBA waiver has been issued. Because this acquisition is below the simplified acquisition threshold, the Nonmanufacturer Rule does not apply. Question 2: Are Canadian-manufactured Thordon OEM bearings acceptable under the applicable Buy American requirements? Answer: Offerors may quote Canadian-manufactured Thordon brand bearings under this solicitation. If an offeror proposes a foreign-manufactured end product, the offeror shall identify that end product in the Buy American Certificate. The Government will evaluate quotations in accordance with the solicitation and applicable FAR provisions. Question 3: Please confirm the applicable NAICS code, as the classification section identifies 332991 while the solicitation description identifies 332291. Answer: The correct NAICS code for this solicitation is 332991, Ball and Roller Bearing Manufacturing. The reference to 332291 in the solicitation description is hereby corrected. Question 4: Is an OEM authorization letter or certificate of conformity required with the quotation? Answer: No. The solicitation does not require submission of an OEM authorization letter or certificate of conformity with the quotation. Offerors remain responsible for submitting quotations that clearly identify the items offered and demonstrate compliance with the solicitation requirements, including the Thordon brand-name-only requirement. Question 5: If an authorized supplier ships the products directly to the Government, must that supplier be identified under the subcontractor disclosure requirements? Answer: Yes. If an offeror anticipates using an authorized supplier to furnish the quoted items for performance of this contract, including direct shipment to the Government, that supplier shall be identified in the subcontractor information required by the solicitation. Except as expressly modified by this amendment, all other terms and conditions of the solicitation remain unchanged. The complete itemized requirement, including quantities, part numbers, and specifications, is contained in the attached Statement of Work and associated line-item schedule. All items must be delivered on an F.O.B. Destination basis to Seattle, WA by March 1, 2027. This acquisition is a 100% total small business set-aside under NAICS code 332991, with a corresponding small business size standard of 1,250 employees. The applicable Product Service Code is 3120. The following factors will be used to evaluate offers: 1. Technical Capability (Pass/Fail) 2. Past Performance (Pass/Fail) 3. Total Price A quotation must receive an Acceptable rating for all non-price factors to be eligible for award. Among all acceptable quotations, award will be made to the responsible offeror submitting the lowest evaluated price. To establish Technical Capability (Pass/Fail), the quotation must demonstrate a clear understanding of the work statement requirements, conform strictly to all specifications in the attached Statement of Work, and provide any adequate capability and corporate experience documentation required by the solicitation. Failure to meet these criteria will render the quotation unacceptable. The Government will evaluate recent (completed within the last three years) and relevant past performance to assess the likelihood of successful performance. Past performance will be evaluated on an acceptable or unacceptable basis. To receive an acceptable rating, past performance must demonstrate a rating of satisfactory or higher performance of similar work. Offerors without recent or relevant past performance will be assessed as "Neutral" and considered acceptable for award. Past performance demonstrating marginal or below performance is unacceptable. Offerors shall identify all subcontractors anticipated to perform work under this contract. For each subcontractor, the offeror shall provide the subcontractor�s name, address, point of contact, phone number, the specific work items/specifications they will perform, and the percentage of work they will execute. Submit offers electronically via email to the points of contact identified in this notice. The Government does not prescribe a specific quotation format. Offerors must submit a quotation that clearly identifies the items offered and demonstrates compliance with the stated requirements. Submissions must be complete, clear, and presented in a format that allows effective evaluation by the Government. Submit all questions via email to the points of contact identified in this notice. The Government will not accept telephone inquiries. Submit offers on a firm-fixed-price basis. Prices must be all-inclusive and must cover all costs associated with providing the supplies, including but not limited to manufacturing, packaging, handling, transportation, duties, tariffs, fees, and any other costs. NIDDK�s Obesity and Diabetes Clinical Research Section (ODCRS), Phoenix Epidemiology and Clinical Research Branch (PECRB), conducts inpatient and outpatient studies involving energy balance, weight gain, obesity, and type 2 diabetes. These studies depend on precisely controlled diets, accurate food measurements, and consistent preparation methods. The Metabolic Kitchen prepares and delivers meals in accordance with established research protocols and documents dietary information used in research analyses. The Government requires two full-time qualified cooks to support the continued operation of the Metabolic Kitchen and maintain continuity of services for ongoing clinical research. Services shall be performed in accordance with Attachment 1, Statement of Work (SOW), and include: Preparing, cooking, assembling, and labeling foods, fluids, and special liquid formulas for controlled diets, test meals, and specialized feedings. Following standardized recipes, menus, preparation methods, and research protocols. Precisely weighing and measuring ingredients and portioning foods to meet prescribed serving sizes and nutrient requirements. Coordinating food preparation to meet scheduled meal-service times. Evaluating food quality throughout preparation. Operating kitchen equipment safely and maintaining sanitary preparation, storage, and work areas. Recording food temperatures and properly labeling, dating, storing, and rotating foods. Stocking study vending machines and refrigerators according to designated food lists. Delivering and retrieving participant meal trays. Weighing and documenting uneaten food and returned food packaging. Coordinating with nutrition personnel, research staff, and research participants as required by the SOW. Attachment 1 establishes the complete performance requirements. (16) Basis for Intended Sole-Source Award Revolutionary Solutions, LLC currently provides Metabolic Kitchen Cook Services supporting ODCRS�s ongoing clinical research. Its assigned cooks have demonstrated experience preparing protocol-specific diets, performing precise food measurements, maintaining research documentation, and coordinating with dietitians and research personnel as protocol requirements change. The requirement extends beyond general food preparation. Personnel must consistently prepare precisely measured meals, maintain accurate portioning, and document food intake and leftovers in accordance with established research protocols. Errors or inconsistencies could affect dietary measurements and the integrity of ongoing research data. Transitioning to another contractor could require recruiting, onboarding, and training personnel while maintaining daily meal services for enrolled research participants. Interruptions or errors during this process could disrupt scheduled research activities and compromise continuity of dietary data. The proposed award would preserve the specialized operational knowledge of the currently assigned cooks and support consistent execution of these protocol-sensitive services. The Government will consider timely quotations from other responsible sources demonstrating the ability to satisfy the complete requirement, including qualified staffing, accurate protocol execution, readiness for the required start date, and continuity of daily services. Responses should explain how the source would manage transition activities while maintaining required performance without disrupting ongoing research. (17) Staffing, Schedule, and Qualifications The contractor shall have qualified personnel available to begin performance on the start date established in the resulting award, which is anticipated to be January 1, 2027. The contractor shall provide two full-time cooks. Each cook shall work no more than 40 hours per week, excluding overtime approved in advance. Required coverage may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays. The contractor shall maintain staffing coverage during personnel absences as required by the SOW. Up to 100 overtime hours per cook, for a combined maximum of 200 overtime hours during each 12-month contract period, may be required. Overtime requires advance approval in accordance with the resulting award. Personnel shall meet the SOW�s qualifications, including: A valid food handler�s certificate or obtaining one within 30 days of beginning work. At least six months of experience as a cook or at least one year of food-industry experience involving food preparation and handling. Knowledge of cooking methods and the ability to work independently. The physical capabilities specified in the SOW. Applicable citizenship, facility access, training, and nondisclosure requirements. The two cooks are designated as Key Personnel. Substitutions and replacements are subject to the SOW. title: USCGC POLAR STAR Thordon Bearings
description: The United States Coast Guard Deputy Commandant for Systems (DCS) is issuing this combined synopsis/solicitation on behalf of the Surface Forces Logistics Center (SFLC) to award a firm-fixed-price supply contract, as detailed in the attached Statement of Work. This requirement consists of providing Thordon brand-name-only shaft bearing components in support of CGC POLAR STAR starboard shaft maintenance. Do not list individual line items, quantities, part numbers, National Stock Numbers, or technical specifications in this notice. The complete itemized requirement, including quantities, part numbers, and specifications, is contained in the attached Statement of Work and associated line-item schedule. All items must be delivered on an F.O.B. Destination basis to Seattle, WA by March 1, 2027. This acquisition is a 100% total small business set-aside under NAICS code 332291, with a corresponding small business size standard of 1,250 employees. The applicable Product Service Code is 3120. The Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose quote conforming to the solicitation is most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. The following factors will be used to evaluate offers: 1. Technical Capability (Pass/Fail) 2. Past Performance (Pass/Fail) 3. Total Price A quotation must receive an Acceptable rating for all non-price factors to be eligible for award. Among all acceptable quotations, award will be made to the responsible offeror submitting the lowest evaluated price. To establish Technical Capability (Pass/Fail), the quotation must demonstrate a clear understanding of the work statement requirements, conform strictly to all specifications in the attached Statement of Work, and provide any adequate capability and corporate experience documentation required by the solicitation. Failure to meet these criteria will render the quotation unacceptable. The Government will evaluate recent (completed within the last three years) and relevant past performance to assess the likelihood of successful performance. Past performance will be evaluated on an acceptable or unacceptable basis. To receive an acceptable rating, past performance must demonstrate a rating of satisfactory or higher performance of similar work. Offerors without recent or relevant past performance will be assessed as "Neutral" and considered acceptable for award. Past performance demonstrating marginal or below performance is unacceptable. Offerors shall identify all subcontractors anticipated to perform work under this contract. For each subcontractor, the offeror shall provide the subcontractor�s name, address, point of contact, phone number, the specific work items/specifications they will perform, and the percentage of work they will execute. Submit offers electronically via email to the points of contact identified in this notice. The Government does not prescribe a specific quotation format. Offerors must submit a quotation that clearly identifies the items offered and demonstrates compliance with the stated requirements. Submissions must be complete, clear, and presented in a format that allows effective evaluation by the Government. Submit all questions via email to the points of contact identified in this notice. The Government will not accept telephone inquiries. Submit offers on a firm-fixed-price basis. Prices must be all-inclusive and must cover all costs associated with providing the supplies, including but not limited to manufacturing, packaging, handling, transportation, duties, tariffs, fees, and any other costs. The Government may consider offers nonresponsive if they include conditional pricing, price escalation language, or statements indicating that prices are subject to adjustment based on future costs or fees. The Government intends to evaluate offers and make award without discussions; therefore, offerors should submit their best offer with initial submission. The Statement of Work and the list of applicable FAR provisions and clauses are attached to this notice.

title: Develop Wayfinding Strategy for Mississippi Lake National Wildlife Area (MLNWA), St Clair National Wildlife Area (SCNWA) and Big Creek National Wildlife Area (BCNWA)
description: Background Canadian Wildlife Service (CWS) Ontario manages 10 National Wildlife Areas in Ontario. Two of these, Prince Edward Point National Wildlife Area (PEPNWA) and Big Creek National Wildlife Area (BCNWA) have also been designated as Connecting Canadians to Nature sites. Out of more than 60 National Wildlife Areas across the country only 10 have been designated as Connecting Canadians to Nature sites. These 10 sites as well as select few of the other NWAs are open to the public and provide opportunities for people to experience and connect with nature. CWS Ontario is working to improve accessibility and enhance visitors’ experiences at publicly accessible NWAs in Ontario. In 2025, a wayfinding strategy and upgrades to signage were completed at PEPNWA to improve accessibility for visitors. CWS Ontario is now looking to implement similar improvements at other publicly accessible NWAs in the province using guidance developed for PEPNWA. Objective Develop Wayfinding Strategy for Mississippi Lake National Wildlife Area (MLNWA), St Clair National Wildlife Area (SCNWA) and Big Creek National Wildlife Area (BCNWA) and complete signage designs as required based on outcomes of individual site visits and using guidance outlined in Design Brief (Appendix B) and Wayfinding Signage Design Intent (Appendix C) previously prepared for PEPNWA.
